content.comment_body: I'm wondering if there is any plan to change the number of available inputs and outputs in the current software. I need to use more than the present 16 outputs, since my hardware has 24 outputs, but I can't access all of them right now. Can you clarify why the software sets such a low limitation?
Hello, this is straightforward to explain. The limitation comes from [product_name], which cannot process more than 24 inputs and 16 outputs.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a restriction in the number of outputs allowed by the software, wanting to utilize all outputs available on their hardware. The software supports fewer outputs than the hardware provides, resulting in an inconsistency and user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the software to enable full use of the hardware's outputs and is seeking an explanation or a software update to resolve the limitation.
